# Deep Work

By Newport.

The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming. Lent my copy to Ben, ask for it back in Friday meeting. The writing is clear and the examples are memorable.

Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later. Not as good as the previous book by the same author. David recommended it after our conversation about focus.

The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked. A good book for a long flight. I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day.

Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.
